title: The Mountain Men
description: Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.

title: The Fighting Marshal
description: Tim Benton (Tim McCoy) escapes from prison and takes over a marshal's identity to bring the men who framed him for murder to justice.

title: The Westerner
description: A rancher (Tim McCoy) and his buddy (Joseph Sauers) scare rustlers out of business.

title: North From the Lone Star
description: Wild Bill Hickok (Bill Elliott) puts on a badge to clean up a town.

title: The Professionals
description: A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.

title: The Gun That Won the West
description: Superior Springfield rifles help scouts (Dennis Morgan, Richard Denning) and the cavalry get forts built in Wyoming.

title: Blazing the Western Trail
description: A stagecoach operator calls on the Durango Kid when an evil rival attempts to drive him out of business.

title: Rio Grande
description: The conniving Ed Barker murders a rancher and tries to steal the ranch from his widow, Jean Andrews. However, their old friend Cliff Houston appears on the scene to try and save the day.

title: Relentless
description: Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.

title: The Nevadan
description: An undercover U.S. marshal (Randolph Scott) and a crooked rancher follow an outlaw (Forrest Tucker) to stolen gold.

title: Two Rode Together
description: A Texas marshal (James Stewart) and a cavalry officer (Richard Widmark) recover long-held captives from Comanches.

title: Montana Territory
description: A cowgirl vigilante (Wanda Hendrix) proves to a deputy (Lon McCallister) that the sheriff (Preston Foster) is an outlaw.

title: The Return of Daniel Boone
description: The scout's grandson (Bill Elliott) foils land-grabbers; his sidekick (Dub Taylor) flirts with twins.

title: Three Hours to Kill
description: The inhabitants of a small western community turn on Jim Guthrie (Dana Andrews) when he becomes the prime suspect for a murder he didn't commit.

title: Desert Vigilante
description: The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) bags Mexican-border silver smugglers for Uncle Sam.

title: Last of the Comanches
description: A cavalry sergeant (Broderick Crawford) leads soldiers, civilians and an Indian (Johnny Stewart) on a desert trek.

title: The Blazing Trail
description: A worthless gold mine leads the Durango Kid and a newspaperman on a trail marked by suspicion and deceit.

title: Legend of the Golden Gun
description: An Old West gunfighter (Hal Holbrook) turns a young farmer (Jeff Osterhage) into a justice fighter with a special gun.

title: The Last Frontier
description: Three trappers become scouts for a cavalry captain (Guy Madison) who loses his fort to a hated colonel (Robert Preston).

title: The Prescott Kid
description: A cowboy finds himself in serious trouble with a notorious outlaw.

title: The Desert Horseman
description: The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) catch up to payroll robbers.

title: Streets of Ghost Town
description: The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) look for stolen gold with a history.

title: Alvarez Kelly
description: A Confederate colonel (Richard Widmark) makes a cattleman (William Holden) teach his troops how to herd Union cattle.

title: Major Dundee
description: A Union major (Charlton Heston) chases Indians to Mexico with a condemned Confederate captain (Richard Harris) and a cavalry of prisoners.

title: Avenging Waters
description: A lone cowboy (Ken Maynard) gets the bad guys and wins the gal (Beth Marion).

title: Gunman's Walk
description: A rugged rancher (Van Heflin) with good and bad sons can only stop his bad son (Tab Hunter) with a gun.

title: The One Way Trail
description: Tim thinks saloon owner Coldeye killed his brother. Seeking the ultimate payback, Tim gets a job in the saloon but has no idea he is targeting the wrong man.

title: Count Three and Pray
description: A preacher (Van Heflin) with a reckless past rebuilds a church after the Civil War with a teenage girl (Joanne Woodward) from the hills.

title: The Stranger Wore a Gun
description: A man whose life was saved by an outlaw shows his gratitude by reluctantly assisting in a stagecoach robbery.

title: White Eagle
description: An Indian pony-express rider C1 catches post-Civil War horse thieves.

title: Prairie Schooners
description: Wild Bill Hickok (Bill Elliott) and his pal (Dub Taylor) take a wagon train through Indian country.

title: Gun Fury
description: A peaceful man (Rock Hudson) hunts down the outlaw (Phil Carey) who has abducted his bride (Donna Reed).

title: Jubal
description: A Wyoming rancher's (Ernest Borgnine) wife eyes a drifter (Glenn Ford), and her ex-lover (Rod Steiger) tells her husband.
